duplicate_execution_rule: At most one ACTIVE claim may exist for one command_id.
lease_rules: ACTIVE claim becomes ineligible when observation time is after lease_expiry or heartbeat_deadline.
Lease recovery creates a new claim/lease_epoch; expired history is never rewritten.
A worker must not execute from an EXPIRED, RELEASED or REVOKED claim.
collision_rules: Claims are normalized to canonical path/resource/dependency keys before comparison.
Two ACTIVE claims conflict when canonical path claims overlap, resource_claims intersect, or dependency_claims intersect in a mutation-exclusive dependency closure.
Path collision includes exact equality and ancestor/descendant prefix after canonical slash normalization.
Collision is evaluated before mutation; no global lock is required for unrelated claim closures.
Shared read-only resources should not be represented as mutation-exclusive claims.
acquisition_preconditions: Worker is eligible under worker registry and has capacity.
CURRENT_HEAD == command.expected_head; P4.5 owns stale-head handling.
